author: Christine Cartwright
text:
Had to have my septic inspected and pumped per the city requirement.  Customer service was very good.  They were able to get me on the schedule within a week.  They take care of getting the permit and billing over the phone.
Zack came out, explained what was needed and made the process as good as it could be under the circumstances.   He was respectful of my property and took the time to make sure I understood everything.

author: Eric Haugen
text: Olson did an excellent job on our lift station replacement. They were the only people who were willing to do the job, and the price seemed very reasonable considering the amount of labor and skill. Just like most big jobs, there were complications that came up, but Olson handled them gracefully. Their office staff and onsite crew were sympathetic and professional. We look forward to many years of worry-free flushing.

author: Jessica Brown
text: Great customer service! This is now the 3rd time I have used them. Very professional and fair pricing.
